questions.text: What does peace feel like to you when you experience it?
questions.verse_text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

questions.text: What keeps your mind from resting?
questions.verse_text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

questions.text: When was the last time you felt truly at rest?
questions.verse_text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

questions.text: Do you feel like you're constantly carrying a heavy load?
questions.verse_text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

questions.text: What would it look like to truly surrender your worries to God?
questions.verse_text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

questions.text: Is there something you need to let go of to find peace?
questions.verse_text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

questions.text: How do you usually try to find peace - and does it work?
questions.verse_text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

questions.text: Is there a situation where you need to 'be still' and let God handle it?
questions.verse_text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

questions.text: What would your life look like if you lived from peace rather than for peace?
questions.verse_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

questions.text: Would you like to breathe deeply and receive God's peace right now?
questions.verse_text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
